title: The Quiet Tryouts
author: Rosalind Quintana
blurb: Beatrix Oyelaran, a debate champion who can't win the argument at home, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. But when grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does before prom.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
